cohort: Stillbirths and neonatal deaths in Tanzania identified by the 2015-16 Tanzania Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Quality antenatal care and 4 or more antenatal visits were associated with increased odds of hospital delivery for women with complications, but attendance was low and quality of care remained critical, highlighting the need for improved management of APH, maternal anemia, PROM and prolonged labor.
mod_finding: Women with an intrapartum stillbirth were 6.5% more likely to have a C-section for every additional hour before delivery after reaching the birth attendant.
